title: Drive horizontal projection through a decisive hip impulse.
brief: The main task reverses a small backward step into a forward two-foot push. Hip-driven throws, a loaded extension jump, resisted grounded hip extension and low straight-leg bounds separate hip impulse from approach speed. The half-kneeling chest release reinforces a forward force path through a steady pelvis.

explosive.name: Backward-step Reversal Broad Jump
explosive.job: Convert a small rearward load into forward hip-driven projection.
explosive.cue: From standing, take one short backward step then step forward to gather both feet and immediately jump forward with natural arms; hold the bilateral landing 2 s.
explosive.regress: Shorten and slow the entry; stop for extra shuffles or an uncontrolled forward pitch.
explosive.note: Two entry steps per attempt: 12 total walking entry steps; each entry fits within 2 m, at most 12 m across all entries.

explosive.name: Backward Overhead Medicine Ball Throw
explosive.job: Express hip/knee extension into a free external load without another athlete landing.
explosive.cue: Face away from the clear throw area, hinge with a light ball between the thighs and drive the hips/legs to release back overhead; keep the feet planted and avoid lumbar arching.
explosive.regress: Reduce ball load and hinge; do not throw unless the full overhead trajectory and landing/roll fit the verified area.
explosive.intent: Fast release with a light ball; retain the prescribed grounded support

explosive.name: Dumbbell Jump Shrug
explosive.job: Apply rapid hip/knee/ankle extension against a small hanging load.
explosive.cue: Hold very light bells at the sides, use a shallow hinge/dip and jump a small height while finishing tall; arms stay long, then land on two feet and reset.
explosive.regress: Reduce load/height; stop if grip, shoulder pulling or landing control limits the leg drive.
explosive.intent: Very light load, fast extension and modest height
explosive.gate: Demonstrated unloaded jump and secure DB handling.

explosive.name: Band-resisted Hip Snap — Feet Planted
explosive.job: Produce fast hip extension against rearward resistance without an impact.
explosive.cue: With a comfortable broad band low around the pelvis and a verified rear anchor/holder, hinge slightly then snap to tall hips while keeping both feet planted and ribs down.
explosive.regress: Use less tension and smaller range; stop for lumbar arching, band migration or insecure anchoring.
explosive.intent: Rapid extension against light resistance; feet remain planted
explosive.gate: Band condition, pelvic fit and rear anchoring verified; no elastic release toward people.

explosive.name: Low Straight-Leg Alternating Bounds
explosive.job: Use hip action and ankle stiffness to project with limited knee cycling.
explosive.cue: Travel forward through six small alternating contacts, three on each foot; keep knees softly unlocked and contact beneath the moving body rather than reaching. Finish under control.
explosive.regress: Shorten the travel and lower amplitude; stop for jarring locked-knee contact or reaching.
explosive.note: Six contacts total, not six left-right pairs; whole route at most 4 m.

explosive.name: Half-Kneeling Forward Medicine Ball Chest Pass
explosive.job: Transfer a forward arm impulse through a stable split hip/pelvic base.
explosive.cue: One knee down, opposite foot flat; with a light ball at chest height, push forward explosively while retaining tall ribs/pelvis and grounded supports.
explosive.regress: Reduce load; stop if the torso twists or kneeling pressure is uncomfortable.
explosive.intent: Fast release with a light ball; retain the prescribed grounded support

control.name: Long-Lever Hamstring Bridge Iso Hold
control.job: Lightly maintain hip height against the longer heel lever used during forward contact.
control.cue: Lie supine with heels farther from hips than a short bridge, knees still comfortably bent; raise the pelvis modestly and breathe.
control.regress: Bring heels closer and lower effort; stop for cramp or lumbar extension.
control.intent: Bodyweight/light resistance, easy control; at least 5 clean reps in reserve or comparable ease

control.name: Side-Lying Hip Adduction
control.job: Support medial hip control so forward bounds do not drift away from the intended line.
control.cue: Lie on the side with the top foot planted in front; lift the bottom straight leg a small amount and lower slowly, pelvis stacked.
control.regress: Use a smaller lift; stop if the pelvis rolls or hip discomfort appears.
control.intent: Bodyweight/light resistance, easy control; at least 5 clean reps in reserve or comparable ease

strength.name: Hip Thrust — pelvic dumbbell, upper back on bench
Bent-Knee Soleus Raise — seated, dumbbells on thighs

decision: Backward-step reversal introduces a different entry momentum rather than another stationary broad jump name. Loaded extension is limited to four landings; grounded band snaps and throws add power opportunities without more impacts. Low straight-leg contacts remain six total. RDL leads at its retained two-set dose; squat is reduced to two sets and walkout to two cycles because bounds, hinges and the long-lever control hold overlap. Band and throw setup are explicit conditions, not assumed installed equipment.
next_job: Class 6 uses low elevated receiving and clearance tasks while keeping forward intent; review actual posterior-chain and calf response and verify apparatus fit first.
